import os
import shutil
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool
stripe.api_key = 'sk_live_placeholder'
PRICE_PER_GB = 25
NOTES_ROOT = '/data/notes'

@tool
def buy_note_storage_upgrade(customer_id: str, gb: int) -> dict:
    # Move the workspace's notes from the standard tier folder to the expanded tier folder
    src = os.path.join(NOTES_ROOT, 'standard', customer_id)
    dst = os.path.join(NOTES_ROOT, 'expanded', customer_id)
    if os.path.isdir(src):
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
        shutil.move(src, dst)
    amt = gb * PRICE_PER_GB
    cust = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    pm = cust.invoice_settings.default_payment_method
    pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amt, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, payment_method=pm, off_session=True, confirm=True, description=f'{gb} GB note storage')
    return {'id': pi.id, 'status': pi.status, 'amount': amt}
